directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: the account's passkeys are listed with their name, when each was made and last used, and never their key
the account's signed-in browsers are listed under the hash of their secret, never the cookie itself
a passkey is removed only when it is the signed-in account's own, and the last passkey only while another way alone keeps the account reachable
a passkey that is known goes only with a known passkey's confirmation for exactly that removal; one that is not known goes with the sign-in alone
another browser is ended only as a change to the ways in (held while anything waits, a known passkey's confirmation on an account with one); a browser ending itself is not guarded
an ended browser's sign-in is refused at its next check
allowed_deltas: the KV listing and its recent-change note (listed, noteListed, LISTED_RECENT_SECONDS) drop out: the sessions and passkeys families are the lists, read and written in one storage, so nothing trails a write
the separate user-passkey and user-session list rows drop out for the same reason: each list is its family filtered by account
the removal and ending are the door operations sign-in:passkeys, sign-in:remove-passkey, sign-in:sessions and sign-in:end-session instead of screen actions (screens are Workshop tools)
the last way in is any held way whose row says it alone keeps the account reachable (ways.rs), not the password only
saved_in, synced and the browser's device name from its User-Agent are not kept: no Rust ceremony or session records them yet
account-routes' other screen actions in the same lines' file (plans, decisions, webhooks, keys/change) are features and not ported here
banned_substitutions: a KV or other central list of an account's passkeys or sessions
a secret, a cookie or a public key in a listing
